page.overview:
Who is Aneth?

Aneth was a human female who owned and operated the Mina-Rau General Store on the planet Mina-Rau with her spouse, Kellen. She disapproved of their daughter, Beela, seeing the undocumented toolie Wilmon Paak and unsuccessfully urged her to stay away from him. In 4 BBY, the Galactic Empire began an Imperial Supply Census of Mina-Rau and Imperials visited the store, making Aneth nervous.

The next day, they returned, and Aneth put on a false smile for Imperial Lieutenant Krole when she spoke with him, although she sharply sent Beela inside when her daughter caught the lieutenant's eye. The Imperials then captured Paak's fellow toolie Brasso in front of the store and killed him before being killed themselves by Paak and Brasso's ally Cassian Andor.

Aneth was a human and ran the Mina-Rau General Store with her The couple had a daughter, Beela, who aided them in the shop alongside a P1 adminmech droid Between 5 BBY and 4 BBY, a group of undocumented toolies without visas or shares on Mina-Rau illegally settled down nearby to carry out repairs and befriended Kellen.

Beela became infatuated with Wilmon Paak, a member of the group, but Aneth did not like him visiting her daughter at the store due to his illegal status and urged her to stay away from him. To get around this, Beela would often find excuses during the workday to bring water or supplies to Paak, who knew that Aneth disapproved of Beela seeing him. In 4 BBY, Beela brought water to Paak and his friend Bix Caleen while they were working in one of the fields, prompting Paak to explain to Caleen that Aneth disliked his and Beela's relationship.
